data.title: Abha vs Al Kholood Preview & Prediction - The Stats Zone
data.content:
In their opening eight games of the 2026-27 Saudi Pro League campaign, Abha have collected just two points as they begin this match day sitting rock-bottom, following their promotion back to the top-flight last season.

Al Kholood head into this one on the back of a 3-2 defeat to Al Faisaly the other day. They have started the season steadily with that loss meaning that they have now won three, drawn three and lost three of their nine games thus far. [...] Abha will believe they can put up a fight with home advantage against inconsistent opposition but Al Kholood are the team to be sided with at the Prince Sultan bin Abdul Aziz Stadium.
